# Fixture for PERF-PY-25 (safe)
lang: python
file: app/batch.py
---
def encode_cell(parent_id, value, seq):
    return (parent_id, seq, value)

def process_batch(rows, parent_id, attach):
    seq = 0
    for row in rows:
        for value in row:
            attach(encode_cell(parent_id, value, seq))
            seq += 1
